أتسابق (form VI)
# أَتَسَابَقُ (ʔatasābaqu) /ʔa.ta.saː.ba.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَسَابَقَ (tasābaqa)
# أَتَسَابَقَ (ʔatasābaqa) /ʔa.ta.saː.ba.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَسَابَقَ (tasābaqa)
# أَتَسَابَقْ (ʔatasābaq) /ʔa.ta.saː.baq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَسَابَقَ (tasābaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
